definitions.gloss: sole of a shoe; bottom of a shoe
definitions.explanation: The bottom part of a shoe that contacts the ground.

examples.japanese: {靴底|くつぞこ}がすり{減|へ}った。
examples.english: The soles of my shoes are worn down.

examples.japanese: {靴底|くつぞこ}にガムがくっついた。
examples.english: Gum stuck to the bottom of my shoe.

examples.japanese: {滑|すべ}りにくい{靴底|くつぞこ}の{靴|くつ}を{選|えら}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: You should choose shoes with non-slip soles.

notes:
FORMATION:
{靴|くつ} (shoe) + {底|そこ} (bottom). Rendaku changes そこ to ぞこ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴底|くつぞこ}がすり{減|へ}る (soles wear down)
- {靴底|くつぞこ}を{張|は}り{替|か}える (to resole shoes)
- {靴底|くつぞこ}が{厚|あつ}い (thick soles)
